headline: Viyash Scientific incorporates a step-down wholly owned subsidiary in Vietnam
summary: Viyash Scientific Limited has updated the stock exchange regarding the incorporation of a step-down wholly owned subsidiary in Vietnam. This move expands the company's international corporate footprint into the Vietnamese market. Such overseas subsidiary formations are typically aimed at establishing local operations, manufacturing, or distribution channels. headline: Viyash Scientific appoints Dr. Mallikharjuna Rao Nagineni as Senior Vice President of Human Resources
summary: Viyash Scientific has appointed Dr. Mallikharjuna Rao Nagineni to the position of Senior Vice President for Human Resources. The company announced the appointment to handle its HR operations. Executive changes at this level typically focus on talent management and organizational scaling.
